description: Header file defining functions for collecting system, reboot, and service list statistics for a watchdog component in an embedded or system monitoring context.

methods.name: collectSystemStats
methods.description: Collects all system data and adds it into the runtime stats hash map.

methods.name: collectRebootStats
methods.description: Retrieves reboot statistics and adds them into the runtime stats hash map.

methods.name: collectServiceListStats
methods.description: Gathers statistics for all services running from the Watchdog and populates the runtime stats hash map.
